title: Choose the composition
question: Which composition should carry the canon build? Approve one, or add a steer note to combine or revise.

options.label: Structured Standard
options.lineage: the category's classic arrangement, at Linear-level craft
options.thesis: Balanced hero, three service cards, case band, funnel strip — the canon at its most legible.
options.viewport: Nav; left-aligned hero with CTA and case link; technical isometric right; services row; StockCast band; steps strip; footer.
options.risk: Most familiar shape; the isometric motif must read as a signature, not decoration.

options.label: Case-Led Editorial
options.lineage: project-led consultancy editorials with generous white space
options.thesis: The StockCast proof owns the hero; quiet editorial rhythm walks the visitor through call, diagnosis, direction.
options.viewport: Minimal nav; asymmetric hero with StockCast chart panel right; numbered how-it-works sequence; services index; footer.
options.risk: Hero is quieter about the offer and depends on real case material being strong.

options.label: Instrument Console
options.thesis: The diagnosis scorecard is the hero: evidence and risk made visible before the first click.
options.viewport: Nav with call CTA right; two-column hero with diagnosis scorecard widget; ledger-style services rows; StockCast band; footer.
options.risk: Densest of the three; needs disciplined tabular type to stay calm, and the scorecard must feel like real method, not decoration.
